notes: This template acknowledges NOTHING and therefore refuses the perception lane. It is the state MyJewl ships in, on purpose.

To enable the lane on a deployment: copy this file somewhere outside the repository, set status to 'declared', name a real person in declared_by, set a real expiry, and list EVERY condition MyJewl currently reports under accepted_conditions. Then point MYJEWL_PERCEPTION_ACK at it.
Listing a condition does not fix it. It records that a named human read that specific sentence and chose to serve diagnostic output anyway.
There is no wildcard. If MyJewl reports a condition that is not in your list, the lane refuses -- including a condition that did not exist when you signed this.
